scope: Read-only technical preflight before commercial outreach

hypotheses.H0: No reliable current technical evidence is available; classify as HOLD_RESEARCH.
hypotheses.H1: At least one target hostname resolves and completes verified TLS and an HTTPS request.
hypotheses.H2: DNS, TLS, redirect, or HTTP behavior is inconsistent or fails; classify the affected check without inferring why.
hypotheses.H3: Technical reachability is not evidence that the company is operating, that a decision-maker is reachable, or that a commercial offer is wanted.

pass_fail.technical_pass: At least one domain resolves, verified TLS succeeds, and HTTPS returns an HTTP response; record exact host, status, and timestamp.
pass_fail.technical_fail: No domain completes the required checks; retain error evidence and do not alter DNS or hosting.
pass_fail.hold_research: Evidence is incomplete, inconsistent, stale, or only from third-party listings.
pass_fail.commercial_pass: Only after a human confirms the company contact and explicitly authorizes the offer; separate from technical PASS.

provenance.raw_output: operator must preserve the JSON output with the run record

guardrails: No automated email, forms, or other outreach.
Do not interpret HTTP 200 as proof the business is active.
Do not interpret DNS/TLS failure as proof the company is closed.
Do not use old third-party contact records without verification.
No post-hoc changes to the frozen checks or pass criteria.
